calls.title: Kevin Yang and Ashley Stirrup + Christian Liebenow
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around the complexities of evaluating AI models, particularly in handling non-deterministic outputs and establishing quality measurement methods. Anthropic's experimentation model emphasizes automated review processes to filter poor model updates before user testing, while metrics from user engagement patterns act as alternative quality signals since direct feedback is minimal. GrowthBook was highlighted for its flexible governance around feature flags, offering version control similar to GitHub and integration with organizational structures for enhanced experimentation. Additionally, the platform's dynamic traffic allocation through contextual bandits and secure querying capabilities were noted, as well as its strengths in providing a visual editor for marketers, supporting compliance and control in regulated environments.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flags, AI Evaluation, Governance, GrowthBook, Split.io
